verdict.rationale: Blink's own docs show secure SSH and Mosh access to remote hosts. This includes Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA key auth, saved hosts, local tunnels (-L), ProxyCommand jump access and ssh-agent, which covers secure access to servers wherever they live. Nothing in the evidence addresses Kubernetes clusters or infrastructure access beyond SSH-reachable hosts. missing for 10: any Kubernetes cluster access (kubectl/kubeconfig, cluster auth), infrastructure-access features beyond plain SSH tunneling, independent corroboration of secure remote-access depth.
